en: A black-and-white photograph of a quiet small-town street. On the left is a two-story, light-colored house or inn with steep gabled roof and two chimneys. Trees line the middle of the image, partly obscuring other buildings in the background. The street appears unpaved or lightly paved, and there are power poles and wires to the right. The sky is bright and mostly featureless. There is no clearly legible text visible on the buildings or elsewhere.
